% E2E canonical fixture — display math (cascade #4).
%
% Exercises the display after_math branch (TeX:The Program §1199-§1206):
% a STANDALONE-paragraph display (§F.2 boundary) centred in
% \displaywidth, an \over fraction at display style, and an \eqno number set
% flush right.  The glyph stream + positions byte-compare to MiKTeX-pdfTeX 4.19
% within the tolerance (+/-0.5pt V / +/-0.1pt H).
%
% Under the bundled plain.tex format the math families (\textfont0..3) and the
% \over macro are set up; \eqno is a display-math primitive.
\hsize=6.5in
\vsize=8.9in
\nopagenumbers
$$x = {a+b\over c}\eqno(1)$$
\bye
